title: R2 vs B2 vs Garage — comparative research, clean accept

reasons: R2 and B2 pricing, free tiers, and egress allowances are concretely captured, and Garage hardware, replication, and operational burden are well documented.
Three success criteria are unsatisfied: B2 S3 compatibility is only a page pointer, B2 durability/recovery is unverified, and Garage has no quantitative cost model for direct comparison.
The remaining gaps are specific and stage-2-resolvable rather than analysis errors, so further targeted research is the correct next step.
Garage cost comparison is not settled because storage cost rests on one unvalidated affiliation-unknown TCO model and no Garage request/operations cost is stated.
Durability/recovery for R2 and B2 remains vendor-only, partly contested, and partly stale, so accepting 11-nines as settled would violate the evidence standard.
R2 object-level S3 compatibility has zero collected evidence, leaving a key tooling question unanswered.
Stage 2 planning exists, but criteria 1 and 4 remain unsatisfied until targeted research fills these gaps.
